summary: Elevate your career with our Certified Administrative Professional training. Gain essential skills and knowledge to excel in administrative roles.
lede: Strategic administrative operations training helps experienced support professionals organize executive workflows and improve how work is tracked. Participants practice prioritizing executive workloads, automating routine requests, and coordinating cross-functional projects, while developing dashboards and stakeholder communication plans. It is suited to senior assistants, office managers, operations coordinators, and others responsible for complex executive support, hybrid workflows, or administrative teams.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for experienced administrative professionals who are ready to transition from task execution to operational leadership.
prerequisites: Minimum 3 years of experience in an administrative, executive support, or office management role. Familiarity with basic office software (Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace) is required. No coding experience is necessary.
